schema: privometry.detectors/v1
detectors:
  - id: service-token
    title: Example service token
    category: credential
    kind: pattern
    severity: high
    confidence: high
    secret_type: example_service_token
    applies_to: [action_argument, file_write, memory_file, agent_config, repo]
    keywords: [exst_]
    pattern: '\b(?P<secret>exst_[a-f0-9]{32})\b'
    samples:
      match: ['EXAMPLE_TOKEN=exst{{}}_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef']
      no_match: ['exst_short', 'EXAMPLE_TOKEN=${EXAMPLE_TOKEN}']

schema: privometry.detectorpack/v1
id: example/service-tokens
version: 1.0.0
title: Example service tokens
description: An example community detector pack that finds the token format of a fictional service. Publishers copy this folder for their own token formats.
maintainers:
  - { name: Example publisher, url: https://example.com }
license: Apache-2.0
min_sensor_version: 0.6.0
categories: [credential]
keywords: [tokens, example]
